course.title: Power System Protection
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: In a 132 kV power system, the circuit phase to ground capacitance is 0.02 μF, the (09) inductance is 5 H. Calculate the voltage appearing across the pole of a CB if a magnetizing current of 8 A is interrupted instantaneously. Also calculate the value of pre-insertion resistor to be used across the contact space.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
